versions.changelog:
Initial release of trpg-yaml-to-svg-maps!

- Generates visual SVG maps from existing TRPG YAML map files.
- Reads map node, edge, and region data from maps/ and scenarios/ (initial_map field).
- Outputs a .svg for each YAML map, placed alongside the original file.
- Visual features: rounded rectangles for nodes, labeled edges with arrows, color-differentiated regions, adaptive sizing, and clear Traditional Chinese text.
- Smartly estimates node positions if coordinates are missing.
- Does not modify any original YAML files.
